hook.en: India once exported fine cloth to the world. By 1900 many weavers had become farm labourers. What happened to Indian industry?
hook.kn: ಭಾರತ ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ನಯವಾದ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ರಫ್ತು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು. 1900ರ ಹೊತ್ತಿಗೆ ಅನೇಕ ನೇಕಾರರು ಕೃಷಿ ಕೂಲಿಕಾರರಾದರು. ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೆಗೆ ಏನಾಯಿತು?

narration.en: India once exported fine cloth to the world. By 1900 many weavers had become farm labourers. What happened to Indian industry?
narration.kn: ಭಾರತ ಒಮ್ಮೆ ಜಗತ್ತಿಗೆ ನಯವಾದ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ರಫ್ತು ಮಾಡುತ್ತಿತ್ತು. 1900ರ ಹೊತ್ತಿಗೆ ಅನೇಕ ನೇಕಾರರು ಕೃಷಿ ಕೂಲಿಕಾರರಾದರು. ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೆಗೆ ಏನಾಯಿತು?

body.en: India could not develop a sound industrial base under colonial rule. The world-famous handicraft industries declined, and no modern industrial base replaced them. Britain wanted India to export raw materials for its own industries and to import British manufactures.
body.kn: ವಸಾಹತುಶಾಹಿ ಕಾಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತದ ಕರಕುಶಲ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೆಗಳು ಅವನತಿ ಹೊಂದಿದವು; ಅವುಗಳ ಜಾಗಕ್ಕೆ ಆಧುನಿಕ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೆಗಳು ಬರಲಿಲ್ಲ. ಇದನ್ನು ಕೈಗಾರಿಕಾ ಅವನತಿ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತಾರೆ.

points.en: Twofold motive: raw materials for Britain, markets for British goods
Decline of handicrafts caused unemployment and new demand for imported goods

The value added by manufacturing, and the jobs, went to Britain while Indian handicrafts declined. Values are in ₹ thousand. Export 50 bales at ₹20 and buy cloth back at ₹100 a bale. Who gains the ₹4,000? Switch on "weave in India". Where does the value added go now?
narration.kn: ವಸಾಹತು ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ ಕಚ್ಚಾ ಹತ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಅಗ್ಗವಾಗಿ ರಫ್ತು ಮಾಡಿ, ಯಂತ್ರದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾಡಿದ ಬ್ರಿಟಿಷ್ ಬಟ್ಟೆಯನ್ನು ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಮರಳಿ ಕೊಂಡಿತು. ಉತ್ಪಾದನೆಯ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ಯೋಗ ಬ್ರಿಟನ್‌ಗೆ ಹೋಯಿತು, ಭಾರತದ ಕರಕುಶಲ ಕುಸಿಯಿತು. ಮೌಲ್ಯ ₹ ಸಾವಿರದಲ್ಲಿ. ₹20ಕ್ಕೆ 50 ಮೂಟೆ ರಫ್ತು, ₹100ಕ್ಕೆ ಬಟ್ಟೆ ಆಮದು. ₹4,000 ಯಾರಿಗೆ? "ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲೇ ನೇಯಿರಿ" ಆನ್ ಮಾಡಿ. ಈಗ ಮೌಲ್ಯ ಎಲ್ಲಿಗೆ?

title.en: On the board: Industry under colonial rule

say.en: Handicrafts declined as cheap British machine-made goods flooded in.
Modern industry came slowly. Cotton mills in the west, jute mills in Bengal.
TISCO, the steel company, was incorporated in 1907.
Sugar, cement and paper came after the Second World War.
Capital goods industry was almost absent, and the public sector was tiny.

prompt.en: Match each industry or fact with its description.
prompt.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ಉದ್ಯಮ ಅಥವಾ ಸಂಗತಿಯನ್ನು ವಿವರಣೆಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.

right.en: Came up in Maharashtra and Gujarat, mostly Indian-owned
Came up in Bengal, mostly foreign-owned
Grew mainly after the Second World War
Hardly existed, so machines had to be imported
Declined as cheap British goods flooded the market

explanation.en: Modern industry grew slowly and narrowly; the public sector was small and a base for making machines was missing.

body.en: Modern industry grew slowly in the second half of the nineteenth century. Cotton textile mills, mostly Indian-owned, came up in the western parts, Maharashtra and Gujarat; jute mills, mostly foreign-owned, came up in Bengal. Iron and steel began in the early twentieth century with TISCO in 1907; sugar, cement and paper came after the Second World War.
body.kn: ಹತ್ತೊಂಬತ್ತನೇ ಶತಮಾನದ ಉತ್ತರಾರ್ಧದಲ್ಲಿ ಆಧುನಿಕ ಕೈಗಾರಿಕೆ ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯಿತು. ಹತ್ತಿ ಗಿರಣಿಗಳು ಮಹಾರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ, ಗುಜರಾತ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ; ಸೆಣಬು ಗಿರಣಿಗಳು ಬಂಗಾಳದಲ್ಲಿ. 1907ರಲ್ಲಿ ಟಿಸ್ಕೊ ಸ್ಥಾಪನೆಯಾಯಿತು.

points.en: Low growth rate and small share in GDP
Public sector limited to railways, power, communication, ports and some departmental undertakings

problem.en: A student writes: "Colonial India had no industry at all." Correct this statement using NCERT facts.

steps.en: Some modern industry did exist: cotton mills in Maharashtra and Gujarat and jute mills in Bengal.
TISCO was incorporated in 1907; sugar, cement and paper came up after the Second World War.
But growth was slow, capital goods industries were nearly absent, and handicrafts declined.

answer.en: Industry existed but was small, slow-growing and lacked a capital goods base; traditional handicrafts declined.
